summary: Iteration 8 tested backend and frontend for Badge Celebrations, Proof Share Links, Alert Trends and Apology Texts. Backend: 12/12 new tests passed, and the full regression suite passed 88/88. Frontend (390x844): every requested flow passed. On /driver/drv-2 the celebration modal appeared with title ON-TIME CHAMP and extra chips for speed and volume. After dismissing it, it stayed gone on reload and the API returned an empty list. On the customer screen, a 1-star rating showed apology-box with code SORRY-XXXXX. The share button opened /api/proof/<token> in a new tab and showed the PROOF LINK READY toast. On admin, alert-trends showed rows for all 3 drivers and 4 zones, and trends-total-low matched the API. The follow-up sheet showed 'APOLOGY TEXT SKIPPED (DEMO NUMBER) · CODE ...'. Only minor issues were found. No deprecated Expo packages were found in the reviewed files.

minor.issue: Reasons come from splitting rating_comment on commas. Free-text comments (for example the seeded 'Parcel left in the rain') are counted as reasons, and a free-text comment that contains commas gets split into fragments. Positive tags such as 'ON TIME' are also counted as low-rating reasons.
Any key is accepted. Keys are not checked against the known badge keys (on_time, top_rated, speed, volume).

ui_bugs.issue: The style sets transform rotate 45deg, but the animated pulseStyle transform (scale) replaces the whole static transform. The medal shows as a square, not a diamond. Fix: put the rotate inside useAnimatedStyle, e.g. transform: [{ rotate: '45deg' }, { scale }]. Reference: src/components/BadgeCelebration.tsx:42,75

TAGS is a static list, so positive tags like 'On time' are offered on 1-2 star ratings. They then appear as low-rating 'reasons' in trends (seen: 'ON TIME ×1' under Marcus Reid). Show negative tags for 1-2 stars and positive tags for 4-5 stars. Reference: src/components/RatingPrompt.tsx:85

integration_issues.issue: dismissCelebration ignores errors from POST /badges/seen and then refetches. If that POST fails (offline or flaky network), the full-screen modal keeps coming back and blocks the manifest. Hide it locally (optimistic state) and retry the seen call later. Reference: app/driver/[driverId].tsx:39-45

navigator.share and window.open are called after an awaited POST. Safari may reject this because the user gesture has expired (NotAllowedError, or the popup is blocked). The NotAllowedError would show as a red toast. Fall back to copying the link to the clipboard. Reference: src/components/DeliveryProof.tsx:21-27

issues: The date labels under the daily bar chart are very small (about 8px) and hard to read on mobile.
AlertTrends returns null while loading or on error, so the section silently disappears. There are no loading or error states.

action_items: Fix the BadgeCelebration medal rotation: combine rotate and scale in the animated style.
Hide the badge celebration optimistically on dismiss, even if POST /badges/seen fails.
Offer star-appropriate rating tags. Optionally, count only known tags as trend reasons.
Optional: on web share, fall back to the clipboard on NotAllowedError (Safari gesture expiry).
Optional: add loading and error states to AlertTrends.
critical_code_review_comments: Trends reasons parsing depends on comma-joined tags inside rating_comment. Storing tags in their own array field would make the grouping more reliable.
share_token is included in the public /api/track/{code} Stop payload. The risk is low because anyone with the tracking code can already see the stop.
seed_data_creation: None. Data was reset via POST /api/admin/reset at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0. After a reset, drv-2 and drv-3 each hold badges (drv-2 has on_time, speed and volume), and the reset clears seen_badges. To trigger the apology flow: deliver a drv-1 pending stop via API (verify-qr plus a signature), open /customer/<code>, tap rating-star-1, then rating-submit-button. Headless Chromium has no navigator.share, so the share button takes the window.open path.
